rationale: Strengthened scenario for the C1 obligation: the committed record the recovering replica ignores is no longer installed directly. The harness drives a real proposal on instance (1,0) - handlePropose, the PreAccept round and the fast-path commit broadcast - with the commit delivered only to replica 2, so it produces a legal history in which the owner holds the instance COMMITTED with a real PUT and another replica installed that commit. The recovering replica 0 (a default record) then runs recovery and the same divergence follows: the COMMITTED reply is skipped, the accept round commits a NOOP vector, and the propagation and applied-state observations differ. This removes the prepared-record limitation the earlier reviews recorded. The local construction run shows leader_status 4 and third_status 4 for the proposal, then adopted_committed false, vectors_match false, all_committed_match false and applied_match false.
